For [math](/docs/shell/commands/categories/math/).

<div class='command-title'>Returns the hyperbolic sine of the number.</div>

## Command Type

`built-in`

## Signature

```> math sinh {flags} ```


## Input/output types:

| input        | output      |
| ------------ | ----------- |
| number       | float       |
| list&lt;number&gt; | list&lt;float&gt; |
## Examples

Apply the hyperbolic sine to 1
```nu
> 1 | math sinh
1.1752011936438014
```
